customMethods.name: startSession
onToolChanged
customMethods.script:
st = BlueRidge.Cutover.Scan.getState(self.session)
	itemId = st["session"].get("itemId")
	st["cavityOptions"] = BlueRidge.Tools.Tool.listCavitiesForItemTool(itemId, toolId)
	st["entry"]["toolCavityId"] = None
	st["entry"]["cavityCode"] = ""
	self.session.custom.cutover = st

customMethods.name: addBasket
customMethods.script:
appUserId = self.session.custom.appUserId
	termId = None
	try:
		termId = self.session.custom.terminal.terminalLocationId
	except:
		termId = None
	res = BlueRidge.Cutover.Scan.addBasket(appUserId, termId, self.session)
	BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult(res, "Basket added", res.get("Message") if res else None)
